contenders.handicapper_notes: Scott Singleton-trained mare gets a supreme setup dropping back from a Tamworth Bm58 into Class 1 and Maiden set-weight company. Carries a lightweight 55kg and lands the coveted inside draw (barrier 2), granting a key tactical rail advantage. Boasts provincial form including a third at Newcastle over 1900m and a fourth at Scone over 2200m. Canonical style S maps for the perfect trailing trip before unleashing on the cambered turn.

Consistent Wayne Wilkes-trained on-pacer who will appreciate the removal of key forward rivals post-scratchings. Boxed on bravely when fourth at Armidale over 1900m after cutting out the work in front. Barrier 4 ensures Ben Looker can command early positioning without spending excess energy. Canonical style E allows him to dictate terms at an even tempo around the home turn.

Experienced stayer with multiple runner-up finishes over 2000m-2100m at Gunnedah and Quirindi. Carries a workable 56.5kg with apprentice Gabrielle Johnston aboard. Tactical stalking style P allows him to sit in the slipstream of the leaders and grind away in the run home. Represents massive value at big odds.

Caused a massive 150-1 shock when winning a Class 1 at Armidale over 1900m last start. However, he copped a significant 5.5kg weight hike up to 59kg top weight and is drawn wide in barrier 10. Canonical style S will force him to pass rivals wide on the turn, making a repeat difficult.

Won a Tamworth mile maiden earlier this winter but has struggled to finish off over longer journeys lately. Carries 59kg and jumps from the outside gate 11, facing a tough staying tax. Canonical closer C who relies on a scorching tempo up front to bring his late burst into play.

Veteran galloper with a single victory from 70 career starts. Shows early initiative from low draws (canonical style E) and from barrier 3 will look to contest the lead with Share Our Secret before yielding entering the short Tamworth home stretch.

Benefits from a notable class drop shipping from Tier 2 Provincial grade at Newcastle down to Country Maiden level. Fitter second-up with solid sectional capability, though an 0-for-18 career record keeps her from top billing. Expected to run on strongly into the placings as an S-style swooper.
